title: Consumer Safety Manager, Consumer Safety Regions Europe and MEA
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity. Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science. Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture. About the Role: The Consumer Safety Manager serves as the regional Pharmacovigilance (PV) point of contact for multiple markets across EMEA. This role is responsible for managing day-to-day vigilance activities for Haleon marketed products and products under development, while ensuring compliance with local regulations and global safety requirements. The position also supports interactions with health authorities, external partners, and internal stakeholders to maintain effective safety processes across the assigned region. This position is offered on a fixed-term contract to cover a maternity leave, with an expected duration of approximately 18 months. Responsibilities: Manage day-to-day vigilance activities for Haleon marketed products and products in clinical development across assigned countries. Ensure compliance with local, regional, and global pharmacovigilance, cosmetovigilance, materiovigilance, and nutrivigilance requirements. Monitor local vigilance regulations and implement regulatory updates where required. Perform Quality Control activities, including in-stream checks and Management Monitoring, in line with global standards and local procedures. Deliver Pharmacovigilance training to local departments and relevant third-party partners. Ensure English translations of required safety documentation, including safety cases received from central safety functions. Negotiate Safety Data Exchange Agreements (SDEAs) for local licensing partnerships in collaboration with Legal and Regulatory Affairs. Support and coordinate third-party pharmacovigilance due diligence activities for new business agreements. Provide guidance on Human Safety Information and Adverse Event clauses for non-SDEA contracts. Support local commercial initiatives and clinical development programs from a safety perspective. Ensure compliance with Human Safety Information reporting requirements for Digital, Market Research, and Patient Support Program providers. Maintain up-to-date local product lists and contact lists for assigned countries. Support local literature search activities, where required. Manage DHCPL and DIL submissions to local Health Authorities. Maintain the local Pharmacovigilance System Master File (PSMF). Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or a related discipline. 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical industry. Knowledge of pharmacovigilance and clinical safety procedures, systems, and guidelines. Understanding of global regulatory requirements related to pharmacovigilance and drug safety. Knowledge of regulatory and pharmacovigilance regulations. Effective written and verbal communication skills in English. Experience working with contractual documentation, including drafting and reviewing pharmacovigilance agreements. Ability to collaborate with stakeholders across multiple countries and functions. Experience supporting pharmacovigilance audits at a local and/or global level would be an advantage. Experience within EAEU markets would be beneficial. Why Haleon? Career at one of the leading global healthcare companies. Attractive reward package (annual bonus & awards for outstanding performance, recognition awards for additional achievements and engagement). Extensive support of work life balance (flexible working solutions including working from home possibilities, health & wellbeing activities). Private medical care – for employees and family members. P4P Partnership for Prevention. Family benefits (extra parental leave, caregiver’s policy). Life insurance and pension plan. Multisport card or points on the Multicafeteria Benefits account. Personalized learning approach. Supportive community and integration events. Hybrid work.

About the role Position: Medical Affairs Manager in Wellness (Shanghai), Grade 8, reporting to Wellness Medical Affairs Team Lead Organization: China Medical Affairs, within China R&D organization The purpose of this role is to support the delivery of medical excellence and medical leadership mainly on hospital/pharmacy channel, to provide strong medical support on innovation projects, claims innovation, and lead in vitro & in vivo studies for new claims generation & visualization. Key responsibilities Implementation of China annual medical plan to delivery all objectives/KPIs successfully under Wellness Medical Affairs Team Lead’s guidance. With oversight from Wellness Medical Affairs Team Lead to drive medical communication and data/evidence/new claims generation strategy Taking a medical lead role on hospital/pharmacy channel, to drive medical initiatives’ execution timelines and budget management Conducting medical assessment on formula/active ingredients’ efficacy & safety Implementation of KEE and external scientific engagement activities, may act as an interface on behalf of Haleon with external organizations including Health Authorities, Healthcare Organizations, External Experts etc Serve as a Haleon speaker for consumer education, as well as HCP education, such as public event, academic conference, livestreaming events. Developing medical statement or dossier for inquiries/challenges/consumers complaints/authority With oversight from Wellness Medical Affairs Team lead to support Medical Affairs activities including but not restricted to: Input on medical concepts, ethics and consumers safety and well-being Medical input to data collection and analysis of Haleon products and competitors Review and evaluation medical approval of promotional materials Supporting the China Medical Affairs Team in delivering whole China Medical team’s annual goals and objectives Qualifications and skills Essential Master’s degree or above, Major in Medicine/Clinical Nutrition/Food Nutrition Medical Affairs industry experience (at least 2-3 years) operating in a commercial environment, preferably in the osteoporosis, endocrinology, with IIT/ISS experience. Demonstrated business acumen Demonstrated project management and organizational skills. Proactive, with ability to anticipate and plan, handle multiple tasks simultaneously, make decisions and respond to tight timelines Ability and eagerness to challenge status quo; make quick decisions; and lead/operate successfully in an empowered organization. Strong communication, influencing and negotiations skills. Ability to facilitate alignment and collaboration across groups/regions. Preferred Medical qualification (MD or equiv) or Ph.D degree preferred Minimum 1-2 years of strong, multi-discipline experience including Research & Development, Innovation, Regulatory, Project Management or other functions Please save a copy of the job description, as this may be helpful to refer to once the advert closes.
